sources.snippet: Model Card for SmolLM3-Custom-SFT This model is a fine-tuned version of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B. It has been trained using TRL. Quick start

sources.title: Supervised Fine-Tuning with SmolLM3 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the cornerstone of instruction tuning - it’s how we transform a base language model into an instruction-following assistant. In this section, you’ll learn to fine-tune SmolLM3 using real-world datasets and production-ready tools. What is Supervised Fine-Tuning ...
